title: dulles_route
description: Resolves origin/destination (label or node id) against oracles/dulles_toll_road.json and oracles/dulles_greenway.json to a route and its price. Both facilities are fixed-toll roads with no price history, so pricing lives directly in the committed oracles -- no RDS lookup, unlike i66_route/i95_route. A trip confined to one facility resolves to one leg; a trip crossing both (they connect at Route 28) resolves to two legs, summed. at_time only affects Dulles Greenway legs (peak vs off-peak); the Dulles Toll Road has no time-of-day pricing. Design: docs/oracle-tools-spec.md; version enforced by tests/test_tool_schemas.py.

origin.description: Interchange label (e.g. 'Exit 12 - SR 602 (Reston Pkwy)'), case-insensitive, or the oracle's raw node id (e.g. '12') as a fallback.

at_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; a value with no offset is assumed America/New_York. Defaults to now (America/New_York) if omitted. Only affects Dulles Greenway legs' peak/off-peak classification (peak: weekdays 6:30-9:00am eastbound, 4:00-6:30pm westbound) -- the Dulles Toll Road has no time-of-day pricing.

rate_period.description: null for a dulles_toll_road leg (no time-of-day pricing); 'peak' or 'off_peak' for a dulles_greenway leg.

origin.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

destination.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

at_time.description: The resolved, ISO-8601 time actually used for peak/off-peak classification (the caller's at_time, or now in America/New_York if omitted).

legs.description: One leg for a single-facility trip, two for a trip crossing the Route 28 boundary between facilities.

facility_totals.description: Both keys always present ('0.00' if a facility has no legs) -- a stable shape, no branching on key presence.

error.description: Unknown origin/destination identifier on either facility, no direct or connecting trip between a known pair, an ambiguous match, or a malformed at_time.

valid_options.description: Non-empty only for resolution errors, where it lists self-correction candidates. Empty for a malformed at_time, since retrying the same inputs won't fix it.

examples.error: unknown origin 'Exit 99': no matching label or node id on either facility
